release_notes: Orbitra 2.2.0: adds Comparative Analysis across Analytics — period comparison with dashed historical overlays, KPI delta strip, and same-hour pacing in Trends; a new 4th Compare tab for side-by-side comparison of Campaigns, Offers, Landings, Creatives, multi-periods, and custom segments with theme-synced colors, line styles, normalization (%), presets, and leader benchmark table; and period comparison deltas in Reports.
